description: PS5 homebrew cheat loader and real-time game modifier — supports .shn, .mc4, and .json formats with automatic game detection. Compatible with FW 4.xx - 12.xx.

changelog: If you find this project helpful, please consider supporting its continued development. Your support is greatly appreciated!
**Real-time cheat toggle** — enable or disable cheats anytime during gameplay, changes apply instantly
**Multi-format support** — `.json` / `.shn` / `.mc4` / `.ShnExt` cheat files, all from a single flat directory (`.ShnExt` is Alpha)
**Automatic game detection** — no manual title ID needed
**Built-in web UI** — served by the payload itself and opened from the home-screen tile
**Cheat credits** — author names are read from the cheat file and shown on the game page
**Self-recovering service** — comes back on its own after rest mode or a network change
**Stable in-game operation** — no freeze on APR games
